lede: Breadth narrowed into the close: 65 names now clear nine of eleven conditions — 3 fewer than yesterday.
sub: 144 stocks upgraded against 126 downgraded and 728 did not move. 13 crossed into 9+ versus 16 that left, so the top tier lost ground, concentrated in Financial Services and Consumer Discretionary.

reads.breadth: Over 266 sessions the count at 9+ has ranged from 2 to 98. Today's 65 sits in the 91st percentile of that range.
reads.movers: 144 stocks gained at least one condition and 126 lost at least one. Of those, 13 crossed into the top tier and 16 dropped out of it.
reads.cond: Price Contraction broke on 13 names — the single biggest driver of today's 126 downgrades. Outperformance was regained on 26, behind part of the 144 upgrades. Short-term Extension and Long-term Extension passed almost every stock, so tonight's score really separates on the other 9.
reads.sector: Healthcare leads on mean score at 5.80; Telecommunication trails at 4.43. Sectors with fewer than five names are shown dimmed — too small to read as a trend.
